* QE: Add TRUNCATE query by @ohsayan in https://github.com/skytable/skytable/pull/359
* server: Add support for dynamic lists in Skyhash by @ohsayan in https://github.com/skytable/skytable/pull/363

## What's Changed
* bench: Add full spectrum latency analysis and support workloads by @ohsayan in https://github.com/skytable/skytable/pull/349
* server: Support non-interactive backup and restore by @ohsayan in https://github.com/skytable/skytable/pull/350

## What's Changed
* net: Restore support for pipelines by @ohsayan in https://github.com/skytable/skytable/pull/338
* storage: Online recovery by @ohsayan in https://github.com/skytable/skytable/pull/340
* net: Fix RST and thread crash due to multiple HS errors by @ohsayan in https://github.com/skytable/skytable/pull/341
* BQL,QE,SE: Add UPSERT query, BQL query shorthands and fix SE bootup crash by @ohsayan in https:/

- ✨ *inlet*: add support for IPFIX over TCP and SCTP
- ✨ *outlet*: add `SetName()` to exporter classifiers to rename exporters
- ✨ *console*: add buttons to reverse the direction of dimensions and filter
- ✨ *outlet*: add support for SrcOuterAddr, DstOuterAddr and IPOuterTos when decapsulating
- ✨ *orchestrator*: keep data forever when the TTL of a resolution is 0
- 🩹 *outlet*: fix NetFlow and IPFIX flow start timestamps (with `netflow-first-switched`)
- 🩹 *outlet*: decode 802.1ad (Qin

- 🌱 *outlet*: ClickHouse server selection strategy is configurable through `outlet.clickhouse.server-selection`: `sticky-random` (the default) or `round-robin`.
- 🌱 *docker*: update ClickHouse to 26.8 (not mandatory)

- 🌱 *outlet*: add [DB-IP](https://db-ip.com/) support for GeoIP
- 🌱 *orchestrator*: allow several Akvorado databases on the same ClickHouse cluster

*Akvorado* does not use the `networks` ClickHouse dictionary anymore. It is not removed on upgrade: it still holds a copy of the GeoIP databases in ClickHouse memory. Drop it on each cluster member once the new version runs:
# docker compose exec clickhouse clickhouse-client --query "DROP DICTIONARY IF EXISTS networks"
- 🌱 *outlet*: move GeoIP and network attributes from ClickHouse to the outlet

- (mongo) use extended json for operations
- (postgres) dump event triggers, FDW objects, text search, casts, conversions,

## Changed

- Fixed version_check channel defaulting to edge on stable versions creating false upgrade notices

- add %dbs% filename tag to expand database names when ALL+split_db:false
- add restore.create_db and cli create-db variable to control auto db creation
- record database server version in sidecars and usage stats
- (mysql) experimental dump raw_blobs option to write blobs as escaped raw strings
- (postgres) additional trace output
- (postgres) avoid server timeout with long operations
- change name: ALL database backups with split_db: false to be filename _all_
- default backup filename tag omits empty db/

- (mysql) additional tracing output
- (mssql) additional tracing output
- (redis) additional tracing output
- (redis) restore pexpireat routines
- (sqlite) additional tracing output
- (postgres) additional tracing output
Also, there is now a simple benchmark tool for comparing the performance of different ways to retrieve data from the database.  It's still very limited.

Still eliminating some internal things that _might_ cause problems like in #1195 (a crash on shutdown on some systems in some builds, hard to reproduce).  It's possible that 7.10.6 already fixed all these problems, but just in case, we'll take a bit more of the related changes I made in 8.0 and backport them to 7.10.

Fixes some warnings, and hopefully also a crash-on-exit on some systems with gcc 15 that I was unable to reproduce.

This is _not the most up-to-date version_ of libpqxx; the most up-to-date versions are the ones in the 8.0 series.
